narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think a thermometer cannot show less than zero, because zero means no heat at all.
<bookmark mark='drop'/>Zero is only the freezing point of water. Watch the line fall past it on a frosty morning.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The air can still get colder, and the scale has room for it.
